summary: revenue-ops checked in 1 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary:
Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution while routing the following existing affiliate repairs for reconciliation; do not create duplicate requests, requeue, deploy, add telemetry, spend, or claim ROI.

1. amputeenews.com — resolve the pending real Amazon Associates tag prerequisite. Evidence: authoritative site context says Amazon Associates is pending a real tag; site is live with affiliate and analytics capabilities. Expected metric: site-level affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, and commission become attributable; current values remain unknown. Validation: confirm owner-authorized tag, inspect generated affiliate URLs, run existing tests/build, and verify the tag without changing unrelated links. Rollback: restore the prior affiliate configuration if validation fails.

2. americastrikes.com — continue repair of broken and stale affiliate references and the prebuild ASIN/redirect synchronization check. Evidence: existing task records identify broken affiliate replacement, stale affiliate references, and an ASIN-sync check; the tasks are currently blocked by ownership routing. Expected metric: zero unresolved broken/stale affiliate references and every affiliate redirect maps to its registered tracking ID. Validation: deterministic link/redirect scan, ASIN-registry comparison, build, and smoke test. Rollback: revert only the affiliate-reference and validation changes.

3. allthingsmasonic.com — continue the existing bounded affiliate conversion-path repair. Evidence: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; an existing affiliate conversion request is queued. Expected metric: preserve click volume while measuring site-attributed ordered items and commission; no lift is assumed. Validation: inspect CTA destinations, disclosure placement, tracking ID, consent behavior, tests, build, smoke, and rollback evidence. Rollback: revert only the scoped CTA or disclosure change.

4. Fleet attribution — continue reconciliation of the Amazon aggregate row. Evidence: 629 clicks, 28 ordered items, and $4.92 commission are reported under tracking ID 'other' for 2026-09-21 and cannot be assigned to a site. Expected metric: every future site link uses its registered tracking ID; the existing $4.92 remains unattributed. Validation: reconcile named tracking rows and content/site identifiers against matching-period records without assigning aggregate earnings. Rollback: preserve the prior attribution mapping and restore any incorrect mapping-only change.

5. Fleet compliance evidence — reconcile the 17 reported banner, accept, reject, and GA4 findings to site-level evidence before labeling any disclosure gap as confirmed. Evidence: compliance summary reports 17 failures in each category, but the supplied snapshot does not expose the affected-site mapping. Expected metric: each finding is either evidenced with a site and failed check or explicitly retained as unknown. Validation: use the existing compliance scan artifacts only; do not infer missing disclosures from unavailable rows. Rollback: no production rollback; revert only incorrect evidence classification.
